## LEDGER

**(a) Obligations and closers**

**OB-1 — VIOLATOR: long-lived manager owns in-flight fading trails, never records which page each started on, nothing tears them down on page change.** — **CLOSED**
- `tldraw: packages/editor/src/lib/editor/managers/ScribbleManager/ScribbleManager.ts` — read verbatim (1–330). The internal `Session` record (48–56) holds `id, items, state, options, idleTimeoutHandle, fadeElapsed, totalPointsAtFadeStart` — **no page identity**. A bulk_search for `PageId` over the whole file returned **0 matches**. `startSession` (74–99) never captures the current page; `addPoint`/`complete`/`stop` (281–330) search *all* sessions blindly.
- `tldraw: packages/editor/src/lib/editor/Editor.ts` — read verbatim. Constructs `this.scribbles = new ScribbleManager(this)` once at 510, holds it as `readonly scribbles` (1172), and ticks it unconditionally every frame at 10980. `setCurrentPage` (4963–4971) comments *"finish off any in-progress interactions"* but **never touches `this.scribbles`**.

**OB-2 — transient status of an in-flight fetch reset when its scope/key changes.** — **CLOSED**
- `query: packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts`, `packages/query-core/src/query.ts` (fetchStatus owned by a cache-lived observer across key changes)
- `db: packages/db/src/collection/sync.ts`, `packages/db/src/collection/lifecycle.ts`
- `redux-toolkit: packages/toolkit/src/query/core/buildMiddleware/cacheLifecycle.ts`
- `tldraw: packages/editor/src/lib/editor/managers/FontManager/FontManager.ts` — in the same folder; holds in-flight font loads, has `reset` (3 matches), **no `PageId`**.

**OB-3 — a pending selection reset when the scope changes underneath it.** — **CLOSED**
- `table: packages/table-core/src/features/RowSelection.ts` — verbatim: **`autoReset` appears 0 times**, while sibling features `RowExpanding.ts` (6) and `RowPagination.ts` (6) and `core/table.ts` (4) do carry it. Selection is owned by the long-lived table and only ever cleared by an explicit `resetRowSelection`.
- `table: packages/table-core/src/features/RowPagination.ts`, `RowExpanding.ts`, `core/table.ts` — the peers that own the reset-on-scope-change contract (EVIDENCE).

**OB-4 — an interaction still in progress torn down when its scope changes.** — **CLOSED**
- `xyflow: packages/system/src/utils/store.ts` (26 `connection` matches), `packages/react/src/store/initialState.ts`, `packages/svelte/src/lib/store/initial-store.svelte.ts`, `packages/system/src/xyhandle/XYHandle.ts` — in-progress connection state held in the long-lived store; the React and Svelte stores are sibling packages that **do not import one another**.
- `tldraw: ClickManager.ts, EdgeScrollManager.ts, SnapManager.ts, InputsManager.ts` — same folder; verbatim: none of them contains `PageId`, and `ClickManager`/`EdgeScrollManager`/`SnapManager` contain no `reset` either.

**In-repo counterexample grounding every verdict above (EVIDENCE, therefore named in `files` per 6.3):**
- `tldraw: packages/editor/src/lib/editor/managers/SpatialIndexManager/SpatialIndexManager.ts` — read verbatim: `private lastPageId: TLPageId | null = null` (43), rebuild when `this.lastPageId !== currentPageId` (83–86), re-stamp in `buildFromScratch` (99), drop elements whose ancestor page ≠ `lastPageId` (244), `dispose()` nulls it (331–334). This is exactly the contract `ScribbleManager` violates.
- `tldraw: packages/editor/src/lib/editor/managers/CollaboratorsManager/CollaboratorsManager.ts` — 4 `PageId` matches; the other page-aware manager.

**(b) SWEEP MATRIX**

| OB | repos in SWEPT | planned |
|---|---|---|
| OB-1 | tldraw, xyflow, primitives, react, redux-devtools | 5 of 5 ✓ |
| OB-2 | query, db, router, redux-toolkit, jotai, zustand, react-redux | 7 of 7 ✓ |
| OB-3 | table, redux, reselect, zod | **4 of 6 — 3.5 did NOT hold** |
| OB-4 | *(none with its own phrase)* | **0 of 6 — 3.5 did NOT hold** |

Stating it plainly: `stakeout` hit its run allowance after 16 calls, so OB-3 was never carried into tldraw/primitives/xyflow/db under its own phrase, and OB-4 was never swept under its own phrase at all. Those two rows were reached instead by `collateral_damage` folds and verbatim `the_receipts` bulk_search — which is how the xyflow connection-state and tldraw interaction managers entered the answer — but they are not a substitute for the sweep, and files those sweeps would have found may be missing. All 16 roster repos were touched at their pinned commits.
